purpose: Translate the observed scale-conditioned threshold effect into the official decoder ordering, compare simple controls, and quantify repaired versus damaged instances.

data.confirmation: remaining 4500 IDs, already inspected during earlier route development; no new blind-test claim
data.all_gt: retain official crowd semantics in COCOeval; ordinary GT only for structural diagnosis

variants.official_zero: interpolate proto-coefficient logits to input grid, crop, threshold at zero, resize binary to original shape and byte-cast as official 8.4.100 scale_preds
variants.official_gated: same pipeline; measure baseline exported original-image mask area; if area<2304 apply logit threshold .75 on input grid; otherwise zero
variants.official_global: same pipeline, logit threshold .75 for all instances
variants.official_erode: 3x3 one-pixel erosion in original coordinates on baseline masks with area<2304; zero padding outside image
variants.smooth_gated: same official order; threshold .75/(1+(A/2304)^2), with A from baseline exported mask
variants.input_area_gated: same official order; area<2304 is measured on input-grid binary mask, a comparator for coordinate-system dependence
variants.legacy_zero: historical diagnostic order: input-grid logit crop, resize continuous logits to original shape, threshold zero
variants.legacy_gated: historical diagnostic order, original-grid area<2304 then threshold .75

identities: same candidate index in one forward for every variant; never match predictions using rounded confidence scores; empty masks are counted and omitted from all AP exports using the same rule

diagnostics.slots: confidence-first stable one-to-one same-class Box IoU>=.50 from nonempty official baseline candidates; fixed for all variants
diagnostics.states: six structural states using Box IoU .75, Mask IoU .75, and GT coverage by predicted box .95; keep no-slot GT
diagnostics.mechanism_cohort: Box IoU>=.75, actual baseline mask recall>=.95, baseline Mask IoU<.75; actual mask recall differs from box support

checks: zero-threshold wrapper must equal ops.process_mask pixel for pixel on first three real images; mismatch stops run
also measure parity to process_mask_native at input resolution
save original predictions before COCO.loadRes mutation
record exact image IDs, runtime source version, progress, summary and per-GT records
decision: First execute all fixed controls on the development 500. If official_gated improves overall AP and net fixed-slot R75 versus official_zero, run the frozen official_gated and simple controls on the remaining 4500 in a separate Run. Do not change constants using the 4500 results. Smoothness is optional and is retained only if supported by development evidence.
timing_scope: isolated decoder on a single real tensor shape, CUDA synchronized warmups/repeats; not a claim of end-to-end latency
history: Preserve earlier PROTOCOL.json and results as their original scope. This v2 protocol does not retroactively validate historical decoder equivalence.
